boundary_note: Buenos Aires July 1807; Spanish side A is the frozen ally convention, not French command. Earlier Miserere action is context only. Tactical and campaign replacement boundaries are unset; phases are research hypotheses. No feature admission or historical rating fit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A Spanish defenders; people count absent; side B 8,000 British assault troops under Whitelocke.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The Spanish under Colonel Liniers, having repulsed the assault of 8,000 British under Lieutenant-General Whitelocke on the fortress works and put about 3,000 out of action, force the British general and remaining troops to capitulate. The British undertake immediately to evacuate Spanish South America and restore occupied Montevideo; the Spanish promise to return the British prisoners."

citations.quote: Die Spanier unter Obst. Liniers, nachdem sie den Sturm von 8.000 Engländern unter Gen.-Lt. Whitelocke auf die Festungswerke abgeschlagen, und ihnen ca. 3.000 M. außer Gefecht gesetzt, zwingen den englischen General mit dem Rest seiner Truppen zur Kapitulation, wonach die Engländer Spanisch-Südamerika sofort zu räumen, das von ihnen besetzte Montevideo zurückzustellen sich verpflichteten, wogegen die Spanier die britischen Gefangenen auszuliefern versprachen.

claims.rationale: Earlier reviewed establishment, not a count of all July street defenders or civilians. Historian’s reconstruction, not the original roll. claims.value: Deputy adjutant-general Bradford testifies to 7,822 effective at Ensinada, excluding 200 sailors.
claims.rationale: Landed effective population; not officers-plus-rank-and-file inferred from later questions. English original; no translation needed.

claims.value: Bradford gives about 6,128 effective rank and file before Buenos Aires on the night of 4 July, with 1,844 under Mahon including 200 seamen.
claims.rationale: Before-city versus detached force; different denominators from landed troops and Bodart’s rounded assault strength. Bradford says no correct Gower return was available on 2 July.

claims.value: Bradford distinguishes Whitelocke’s main body, Gower’s advanced corps and Mahon at Reduction.
claims.rationale: English original; renderings paraphrase scope. No inference that each brigade’s conduct was personally ordered by the commander-in-chief. English rendering (ours): "The main body was directly under Whitelocke." English rendering (ours): "The force remaining at Reduction was under Mahon."

claims.value: Groussac describes Liniers’s army in three brigades under Balbiani, Velazco and Elío, with Concha over the reserve; later civic and militia leaders participated in the defence decision.
claims.rationale: 24 June army hierarchy and 2 July collective city decision differ; the street-by-street July command network remains unresolved. English rendering (ours): "divided into three brigades respectively commanded by Colonels Balbiani, Velazco and Elío, besides the reserve under naval captain Gutiérrez de la Concha." English rendering (ours): "with the attendance of the volunteer corps commanders"
